# Third-party acknowledgements

The radial basis and cutoff utilities in `irrednet/backbone/radial.py` credit
Ilyes Batatia and Gregor Simm. Some interaction, embedding, tensor-product path,
and scatter utilities follow MACE/e3nn implementations. The retained MACE

PyTorch, e3nn, PyTorch Geometric, torch-scatter, spglib, spgrep, pymatgen, ASE,
